digest.component_or_area: code-review batch runner and finalize step
propositions: The code-review batch runner does not emit Pass-1 finder token usage on its batch step output, causing CloudWatch totals to undercount by the entire finder leg.
The finalize step already contains logic to fold _usage from batch step outputs into totals (lines 169-172), but receives no _usage key from the code-review batch runner.

The plan-review path established a convention via d52a: aggregate call records using aggregate_usage() and emit the result under _usage on the batch step output; the code-review path must mirror this shape.
A stale follow-up comment at finalize.py:139-141 documents the gap as outstanding and must be removed once the batch runner emits _usage.
Unit tests must verify that Pass-1 finder token usage is included in the finalized code-review totals, passing only after _usage is emitted by the batch runner.
